summary: Nominatim is a server application that processes OpenStreetMap data to handle geocoding and reverse geocoding requests. It translates postal addresses into geographic coordinates and converts coordinates back into readable location data. This self-hosted service allows applications to perform mapping lookups locally without relying on external third-party APIs.
goodFor: Self-hosters and developers building location-based services who require a private, local endpoint for address lookup and coordinate translation.
watchOut: Setting up the full planet dataset requires substantial storage space and significant initial processing time to import the geographical data correctly.
deployNotes: As a compiled application processing large spatial datasets, it typically requires a dedicated database backend and persistent storage volumes for optimal performance.
